headline: Clinton changes an earlier order that set up an advisory committee on the public duties of digital TV broadcasters.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13038, which created an advisory committee to study what public service duties TV broadcasters should have as they move to digital signals. The title does not say exactly what was changed. Changes like this often adjust a committee's deadline, membership, or term. The committee only gives advice and does not set rules itself.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Advisory Committee on Public Interest Obligations of Digital Television Broadcasters
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how their committee works were changed, though the source does not say how.
They are the subject of the committee's study, but this order does not directly place new rules on them.
